exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Deciding or Arranging Something".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
Verb る ことになる
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb る ことになる matches "Deciding or Arranging Something".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb る ことになる.
exercises.explanation: Used to show that something has been decided or arranged by others or circumstances.
